premise: I cashed out my $122,000 401(k) to purchase and restore a rare collection of antique maps and terrestrial globes with my nephew, notarizing 50/50 and a promise to print free historical map reproductions for my book club; after a historical society offered $750,000 for the entire library, he forged a dissolution, sold the collection, and sent me a $4,000 'compass' check. I recovered the original partnership paperwork hidden inside a hollow globe’s interior, voided the sale, and now run 'Latitude of Deceit Maps,' where he dusts the globe collection in a shirt that reads 'Off the Map of Trust' and every reproduction map print includes a QR code to his fraud conviction.
